entry.title: Plans
entry.summary: Forward-looking mission write-ups for the example docsite — not the current state (see architecture/).
entry.content:
Forward-looking work for the example site: short mission write-ups live under plans/missions/. Unlike every other section in this example, this section has no README.md — plans/index.md is its section index instead (FR-012/SC-001). It resolves to /plans/, exactly like a README.md-indexed section resolves to its own root, and the two conventions coexist in the same build (this is the mixed-corpus proof: every other section here still uses README.md, unchanged).

  • Mission Alpha — this folder was renamed from plans/features/ to plans/missions/ as a registry-data-only change (SC-002): a git mv plus one subtypes rule in example/docs/_meta/sections.yaml, no derivation code touched.
  • Mission Beta
